# Phase 1
1. Amy finishes cooking breakfast for Will and Amber while humming over the sizzling pan.
2. A zombie (Zombie1) groans, breaks through the kitchen door, and lunges at Will and Amber.
3. Amy grabs Will by the arm and pulls him toward the back bedroom closet, then scoops up Amber and shoves her into the same safe spot.
4. Breathing hard, Amy steps over the breakfast table and pushes open the cabinet door in the kitchen.
5. Under the sink she finds a hidden compartment; inside lies a pistol in its holster and a gleaming katana blade.
6. With pistol in hand and katana gleaming, Amy slices or shoots each zombie that shuffled from the hallway into the kitchen—one after another—until only the last undead stands.
7. When the last of the undead falls to dust, she breathes out slowly.
8. Amy steps toward the back‑bedroom closet, opens it, pulls Will and Amber inside, and brings them back into the kitchen.
